input.summary: Add IBM affiliate/successor assignment carve-out and a reasonableness standard in § 16.2.
input.comment: [Playbook] We added our customary carve-out allowing IBM to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and made consent for other assignments subject to a reasonableness standard. As drafted, § 16.2 blocks IBM's internal reorganizations and corporate transactions entirely, which our playbook does not permit; MSL's assignments remain consent-gated.

ops.oldText: Neither Party may assign, transfer or subcontract any rights or duties under this Agreement without prior written approval by the other Party.
ops.newText: Except as expressly permitted below, neither Party may assign, transfer or subcontract any rights or duties under this Agreement without prior written approval by the other Party, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed. IBM may assign or transfer all or any part of this Agreement, without MSL's consent, to any IBM affiliate or subsidiary or to any successor by way of merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of the assets or of the business to which this Agreement relates, upon written notice to MSL.
